inputs.prompt: ONE original athletic soldier, the Chainford Marshal, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep the adult man with wavy collar-length dark brown hair and a short full brown beard, the long weathered dark crimson military coat with split tails below the knee, engraved copper-bronze shoulder pauldrons, a cream neck scarf, crossed brown leather chest straps, a broad buckled belt with pouches, dark trousers, dark brown knee-high armoured boots with bronze kneecaps and dark leather gauntlets. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. Each hand holds ONE short bronze and dark steel baton ending in a curved hook; ONE heavy steel chain joins the two handle butts and hangs across the front of the body. Both hooks and the chain stay attached and keep their lengths. Preserve the weapons, the coat and adult proportions. Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles. Alternate near and far legs through forward contact, weight loading, passing and lift; both knees articulate and each boot alternates taking weight and swinging. The torso stays centred for engine-driven travel. Both hooked batons are held low at the sides with the chain hanging between them; the coat tails swing with the legs. Finish in the original gait phase. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame. Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full head, both hooks, the chain, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, magic, glow, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; do not morph the equipment.
